dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A) caused by a pathogenic MFN2 gene mutation
Alternative 1: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 1B (CMT1B) due to an MPZ gene mutation
Alternative 2: Distal hereditary motor neuropathy (dHMN)
Alternative 3: Chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP)
dx: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A) caused by a pathogenic MFN2 gene mutation
